# The engine's packages and test tools as CI installs them on Windows (ci.yml: the sidecar job),
# with --require-hashes. The same versions as sidecar/constraints.txt (tests/test_toolchain_pins.py
# checks), plus the build backend the editable install uses (--no-build-isolation). Regenerate from
# the repository root after changing constraints.txt or pyproject.toml's dependencies (test-linux.txt
# and test-windows.txt together):
#
#   echo setuptools==<engine-build.txt's version> > build/in.txt
#   uv pip compile sidecar/pyproject.toml build/in.txt --extra dev -c sidecar/constraints.txt \
#     --python-platform windows --python-version 3.12 --only-binary :all: --no-header --no-annotate \
#     --generate-hashes -o .github/requirements/test-windows.txt
#
# then put this comment back at the top.
